## Raw results · initial augmentation experiment

The MarinMoE models have approximately 1.5B total and 60M active parameters. New inputs include metadata; DNA216B initialization also has 216B prior DNA tokens and half the adaptation LR.

Runs: [text initialization](https://forge.coreweave.com/wandb/eric-czech/marin/runs/dna-exp593-augmented-d768-pretrained-seed0-v1) · [DNA216B initialization](https://forge.coreweave.com/wandb/eric-czech/marin/runs/dna-exp593-augmented-d768-dna216b-lrm0p5-seed0-v1).

## Results by task family

### Zero-shot · 8K token budget (final checkpoints)

Motif accuracy is teacher-forced: later answer bases receive preceding true motif bases. It does not measure complete-motif generation from flanks alone. Frozen motif probes withhold the entire motif.

Complete 20-task sets (1,727,943 examples/readout), plus 94,075 maize AF variants/readout; equal task weights within families and the historical best-strand convention for benchmark tasks. AF averages forward/RC log-odds. “—” denotes unsupported readouts.

Case collapse sums A+a, C+c, G+g and T+t probabilities; both FIM readouts use it. Metadata uses only verified, training-supported fields.

<details>
<summary>Forward × reverse-complement readout and task-level data</summary>

Aligned forward/RC probabilities are combined by an equal-weight geometric mean and renormalized. Each FIM pass already sees both flanks. SV has no corresponding strand-product readout. AF in this table uses variant-site-only odds.
